name: MAC Address Lookup MCP
description: A MAC address lookup with no ads, no cookie popups, and no per-request cost. Its one tool, lookup, reads the public IEEE registries and tells you the vendor, country, and registry of a MAC address or OUI prefix, with a link to more information at mac.jasontally.com. No API key, no account, no session. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: lookup only reads public IEEE registry data. It writes nothing, needs no key, and is annotated readOnlyHint, so it keeps Guard's usual handling.
The MAC address you send to lookup is in the request, so it reaches the host. To keep a lookup on your own computer, use https://mac.jasontally.com in a browser, where the query runs locally.
